patch_list: XP Hero | Choose S-Ticket Trait

Choose S/SS/SSS rarity, stat and set icon in patch settings. S-ticket roll weights favor exactly that combination. Coin-roll rarity/synergy odds unchanged; same-rarity stats are shared. Combine with Free S-Ticket Rolls.
XP Hero | Free Hero Evolve
Experimental: zero hero evolution materials and pieces.
XP Hero | Free Hero Level Up
Experimental: zero hero level-up resource costs.
XP Hero | Free Hero Upgrade (0 Shards)
Experimental: shows 0 shards, credits +1 just before the normal 1-shard upgrade, then consumes it. Net cost 0; do not combine with 1-shard fallback.
XP Hero | Free Rune Upgrades
Experimental: zero both resource costs for all 1,440 rune upgrade levels.
XP Hero | Free S-Ticket Rolls
Experimental: make S-Ticket rolls cost 0 in XP Hero 26.2.0.
XP Hero | Free Shops
Choose which shop categories have zero in-game currency prices. Open patch settings for six toggles.
XP Hero | Free Tickets & Return
Instant free Return portal uses in the field (no daily-reset wait), plus free ticket refills; paid purchases unchanged.
XP Hero | Free Trait Presets
Experimental: zero save/load costs for four trait presets (not rerolls).
XP Hero | Free Trait Rerolls
Experimental: change the ARM64 trait reroll cost calculator to return 0, including for locked traits.
XP Hero | Hero Upgrade (1 Shard - Fallback)
Confirmed working fallback; costs one shard. Disable when selecting Free Hero Upgrade (0 Shards).
XP Hero | Highest-Rarity Tomb Runes
Every rune dropped in Heroes' Tomb uses the highest available grade for the selected difficulty, including three-ticket runs. Original loot counts and ticket costs apply.
XP Hero | Massive EXP Multiplier
Monster EXP 1x–100000x (default 10000x). Optional EXPERIMENTAL level cap 2200; original max 1500 remains default. Extending player level might be rejected by server checks or break existing saves.
XP Hero | Unlock All Heroes (FREE)
Experimental: all heroes cost 0 unlock pieces; the native zero-amount consume path keeps its normal notifications. Other unlock conditions may still apply.
